forms.ex: Lass die Tasche einfach hier stehen.
forms.exEn: Just leave the bag here.

forms.en: leave (a place, a person); sich verlassen auf: rely on
forms.ex: Der Zug verlässt gleich den Bahnhof.
forms.exEn: The train is about to leave the station.
forms.why: ver = away: you let a place go and move away from it.

forms.ex: Sie ist eine sehr zuverlässige Kollegin.
forms.exEn: She is a very reliable colleague.
forms.why: sich verlassen auf = rely on: zuverlässig is what you can rely on.

forms.ex: Bei einem Auto ist mir Zuverlässigkeit am wichtigsten.
forms.exEn: In a car, reliability matters most to me.

forms.ex: Der Bus ist hier leider sehr unzuverlässig.
forms.exEn: Unfortunately the bus is very unreliable here.

forms.en: dismiss, lay off; discharge (from hospital, prison)
forms.clue: to lay off; to discharge (from hospital)
forms.ex: Die Firma hat 200 Mitarbeiter entlassen.
forms.exEn: The company has laid off 200 employees.
forms.why: ent = away, out of: you let someone go out of a job or a place.

forms.ex: Die Entlassungen kamen für alle überraschend.
forms.exEn: The layoffs came as a surprise to everyone.

forms.en: allow, permit; admit (to a course); register (a car)
forms.ex: So ein Verhalten lasse ich nicht zu!
forms.exEn: I won't allow that kind of behaviour!
forms.why: zu = to: you let something come to you, through the door.

forms.en: admission (to a course); approval, licence; registration (of a car)
forms.ex: Ich warte auf die Zulassung zum Studium.
forms.exEn: I'm waiting for admission to university.

forms.ex: Auf dieser Straße ist nur Tempo 30 zulässig.
forms.exEn: Only 30 km/h is allowed on this road.
forms.note: The stem takes an umlaut: zulassen, zulässig.

forms.ex: Diese Frage ist im Vorstellungsgespräch unzulässig.
forms.exEn: This question is not allowed in a job interview.

forms.en: leave on (a light, a coat); start (an engine)
forms.clue: to leave on (a light); to start (an engine)
forms.ex: Lass das Licht im Flur bitte an.
forms.exEn: Please leave the light on in the hall.
forms.why: an = on: you let the light stay on, or let the engine come on.

forms.ex: Zu welchem Anlass schenkst du ihr Blumen?
forms.exEn: What's the occasion for giving her flowers?
forms.why: Learn it as a word: the noun no longer has the sense of anlassen.

forms.en: arrange (for something to happen); prompt, cause (someone to do)
forms.clue: to arrange (for something to be done)
forms.ex: Ich werde alles Nötige veranlassen.
forms.exEn: I'll arrange everything necessary.
forms.why: ver- makes a verb from der Anlass: you give the reason, so it happens.

forms.en: skip, miss out (a meal, a step); vent (anger, on someone)
forms.ex: Ich habe heute das Mittagessen ausgelassen.
forms.exEn: I skipped lunch today.
forms.why: aus = out: you let something stay out.

forms.en: leave (a message, a mess); leave behind (after death)
forms.ex: Bitte hinterlassen Sie eine Nachricht nach dem Signalton.
forms.exEn: Please leave a message after the tone.
forms.why: hinter = behind: you let something stay behind you.

forms.en: leave (it) to someone; let someone have
forms.ex: Die Entscheidung überlasse ich dir.
forms.exEn: I'll leave the decision to you.
forms.why: über = over: you hand something over and let the other person have it.

forms.en: refrain from, stop (doing); fail to do
forms.ex: Bitte unterlassen Sie das Rauchen im Zimmer.
forms.exEn: Please refrain from smoking in the room.
forms.why: Learn it as a word: you let an action not happen.

forms.ex: Der Regen lässt langsam nach.
forms.exEn: The rain is slowly easing off.
forms.why: nach = after, behind: the force lets go and falls behind.

forms.ex: Er arbeitet in letzter Zeit sehr nachlässig.
forms.exEn: He has been working very carelessly lately.
forms.why: Someone whose effort lets up (nachlässt).
forms.note: The stem takes an umlaut: nachlassen, nachlässig.

forms.clue: to let go (of a hand, a rope)
forms.ex: Halt dich gut fest und lass nicht los!
forms.exEn: Hold on tight and don't let go!
forms.why: los = loose, free: you let it go free.

forms.clue: to leave out (sugar, salt in a recipe)
forms.ex: Ich lasse den Zucker im Kaffee weg.
forms.exEn: I leave the sugar out of my coffee.
forms.why: weg = away: you let it stay away.

forms.ex: Wir mussten das Auto am Flughafen zurücklassen.
forms.exEn: We had to leave the car behind at the airport.
forms.why: zurück = back: you let it stay back where it is.

forms.en: sich niederlassen: settle (in a place); set up (a practice, a business)
forms.ex: Die Familie hat sich in Hamburg niedergelassen.
forms.exEn: The family has settled in Hamburg.
forms.why: nieder = down: you let yourself down in a place and stay.

forms.ex: Die Firma hat eine Niederlassung in München.
forms.exEn: The company has a branch in Munich.
forms.why: Where a company has settled (sich niedergelassen hat).

forms.en: issue, pass (a law, an order); waive (a fee, a debt)
forms.clue: to issue (a law); to waive (a fee)
forms.ex: Die Stadt hat ein Rauchverbot erlassen.
forms.exEn: The city has issued a smoking ban.
forms.why: er = out, forth: an authority lets a rule go out to the people.

forms.ex: Gute Deutschkenntnisse sind für diese Stelle unerlässlich.
forms.exEn: Good German is essential for this job.
forms.why: Learn it as a word: what cannot be let off (erlassen) is indispensable.
forms.note: Usually stressed on the stem: uner-LÄSS-lich. The positive erlässlich is hardly used.

forms.ex: Sie bleibt auch im Stress ganz gelassen.
forms.exEn: She stays completely calm even under stress.
forms.why: Someone who lets things be (gelassen) stays calm.

forms.ex: Mit etwas Gelassenheit geht alles leichter.
forms.exEn: Everything is easier with a bit of composure.

forms.ex: Er trägt am liebsten lässige Kleidung.
forms.exEn: He likes wearing casual clothes best.
forms.why: Learn it as a word: related to lassen, things let go easily.
forms.note: The stem takes an umlaut: lassen, lässig.

forms.en: sich einlassen auf: get involved in, agree to; let in (a person)
forms.ex: Auf so einen Deal lasse ich mich nicht ein.
forms.exEn: I won't get involved in a deal like that.
forms.why: ein = in: you let yourself into something.
